question: Can you provide the number of distinct active and closed bike share stations for each year 2013 and 2014?
sql:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN s.station_id END) AS active_stations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN s.station_id END) AS closed_stations
FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t 
  ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time) IN (2013, 2014)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.start_time)
ORDER BY year
